markets.early_close_condition: The market will close and expire early once the 2026-27 Defensive Player of the Year is announced.
markets.rules_primary: If the Pro Football Defensive Player of the Year in the 2026-27 season is on a team in the NFC, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on the conference of the team the Defensive Player of the Year winner is a member of at the time the award is announced, regardless of which team(s) they played for earlier in the season.

If co-winners are announced and both play for teams in the same conference, that conference will resolve Yes. If the co-winners' teams are in different conferences, each corresponding conference market resolves Yes at a value of 1/N, where N is the number of distinct conferences among the tied winners.
